items.title: Automatic Backups
items.subtitle: Apollo can write a settings backup to a folder you pick in Files every day, every three days or every seven days. Off by default, under Settings > Apollo Reborn > Backup Settings.

items.title: Manage Backups
items.subtitle: See every backup on the device, split into Automatic and Manual. The newest ten automatic backups are kept; manual ones stay until you delete them.

items.title: Smoother Scrolling
items.subtitle: Scrolling back down right after reaching the top of a post no longer pauses while Find in Comments settles.

items.title: Header Stays Put While Editing
items.subtitle: With Hide Header on Scroll enabled, the checkmark stays reachable while you reorder the subreddit list or use the alphabet index.
